nextExecutableAction: Lead accepts this preflight artifact. Implementation remains gated: after lead wave0 commit and accepted WP-10/WP-08 typed interface, migration and scenario receipts, rehash inspected shared files and reread changed sections, obtain selected WP-49 anchor/undo binding and WP-51 writer/fence receipts, then extend the existing accepted Pages contracts/repository/commands with CreateAnchoredComment and common Message transaction before UI/history/restore integration. Do not create competing copies of WP-10 files or Message store.
risks: Root integration may change any inspected shared file; hashes are working-tree inspection evidence, not guaranteed future or HEAD proof. Rebase semantic patch requests onto accepted lead revision without Git operations in this worker.
The three normative Pages new files are also WP-10 files; independent replacement would clobber dependency implementation.
WP-15 migration lists message even though WP-08 owns the common Message schema; creating it again violates no-second-store requirement.
Stable start/end strings must use selected CRDT position encoding, not decimal indexes or HTML digest offsets. Quoted-text fallback cannot safely retarget repeated text or deleted selections.

Anchor schema allows minimum 0 while row schema requires >0. Accepted contract must explicitly distinguish envelope versions from persisted domain versions and reject unsupported versions, not silently coerce.

DocumentAnchor supports crdt_position/text_quote/pdf_region/media_span but WP-15 existing surface is Pages/document. Accepted adapters/content-kind validation are prerequisite; the inspection does not claim non-document adapters exist or waive those contract kinds.
Local undo origin semantics across actor/device and restart must come from accepted WP-49 binding; snapshot restore is not selective undo.

Restore conflict/merge policy is named but not fully specified; silently overwriting concurrent edits violates the published risk and acceptance intent. Require accepted precise policy rather than inventing an implementation API.
Existing digest-bound grants/render leases are source-action safety, not shared-resource ACL/history permissions. Shared document lease churn must not remount editor and destroy undo/selection state.
GET_CONTENT/SET_CONTENT and standalone storage can remain a legacy shared-ID authority bypass unless WP-51 guard actually covers them; adding only a new command route is insufficient.

Historical snapshots and orphan quotes can retain revoked/deleted sensitive content. Query, notification, search, activity and linked-ref policy must be rechecked at read/serialization, not trusted from creation time.
Durable CRDT WAL and relational Message/anchor/receipt writes need an accepted consistency boundary and causal revision evidence; early applied/ACK cannot prove durability across crash.
Offline anchors require retained causal positions/tombstone semantics. Pruning snapshots/WAL before replay can turn valid queued selections into unresolvable or wrong anchors.
UI locale additions require all ten locales and Russian plurals according to loaded repository rules; shared localization changes are lead-owned, not preflight writes.
No product, test, manifest, progress, shared-file or Git changes are authorized in this task; no runtime feature verification or completion is claimed.
